subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Writing an evaluation of an advertisement
outcomes: Sort positive and negative words for evaluating adverts
Write a first draft of an advert evaluation with reasons

tf.s: An evaluation includes the writer's opinion supported by reasons.
An evaluation only describes the advert.
tf.why: It must also give an opinion with reasons.

tf.s: 'Memorable' is a positive word for an advert.
tf.why: A memorable ad stays in your mind.

tf.s: 'Irritating' is a positive word for an advert.
tf.why: Irritating is negative; it means annoying.

tf.s: The model evaluation is about Smooth and Shiny shampoo.
tf.why: That is the advert in the model.

tf.s: A second draft is not needed if you wrote a first draft.
tf.why: A second draft helps you correct and improve your writing.

tf.s: An evaluation has an introduction, a description and an opinion with reasons.
'Unrealistic' means very true to real life.
tf.why: Unrealistic means not like real life.

boxes.q: What must an evaluation include besides description?
Which product is in the model evaluation?
boxes.why: The model evaluates a shampoo ad.

boxes.q: Which word links an opinion to a reason?

boxes.why: Unrealistic things could not really happen.

boxes.q: Where can you find the structure of an evaluation?
boxes.why: The Writing Guide shows layout and headings.

mcq.q: What must an evaluation include besides a description?
o: the writer's opinion supported by reasons
mcq.why: Opinion and reasons make it an evaluation.

mcq.q: Which list contains only positive words?
Which list contains only negative words?
What are the parts of the model evaluation?
mcq.why: The model has these three parts.

mcq.q: Which is a good opening sentence for an evaluation?
o: Advertisements try to persuade us to buy a product, but some mislead us.
mcq.why: It introduces the topic of adverts.

mcq.q: Which sentence gives an opinion with a reason?
o: In my opinion, the ad is misleading because it suggests the shampoo will change your personality.
mcq.why: It has an opinion and a 'because' reason.

mcq.q: Your partner's draft has spelling mistakes. What should they do?
o: correct them in a second draft

mcq.q: Why should you write a second draft?
o: To correct mistakes and improve organisation and clarity
To make the text longer only
Because the first draft is always perfect

mcq.q: Why is 'This advert is bad' a weak evaluation sentence?
mcq.why: An opinion needs a reason to support it.

mcq.q: An advert shows a family flying in a car above the city. Which word describes it best?
mcq.why: Cars cannot fly, so it is not like real life.
